rules.source: Loi n° 2013-450 du 19 juin 2013 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel — https://www.coe.int/web/octopus/-/cote-ivoire
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary: law designates ARTCI as the Personal Data Protection Authority (independent administrative authority with regulatory, control and sanction powers; Article 46); prior declaration required; principles of lawful collection, specific purpose, limited retention, security, data subject rights.

rules.source: Loi n° 2013-451 du 19 juin 2013 (cybercriminalité), amended by Loi n° 2023-393 du 07 juin 2023 — https://www.coe.int/web/octopus/-/cote-ivoire
rules.retrieved_snippet: Council of Europe page (search summary): the law defines and punishes offences specific to ICT, IP infringements and unlawful acts on electronic communication networks, and sets out online service provider responsibilities; a UVCI course doc cites Article 8: 5 to 10 years for fraudulent interception of computer data; contents of the 2023 amendment not verified.
